نضطهد (form VIII)
# نَضْطَهِدُ (naḍṭahidu) /nadˤ.tˤa.hi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# نُضْطَهَدُ (nuḍṭahadu) /nudˤ.tˤa.ha.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# نَضْطَهِدَ (naḍṭahida) /nadˤ.tˤa.hi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# نُضْطَهَدَ (nuḍṭahada) /nudˤ.tˤa.
